prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper): preserves reports/clarifications,rationale/authorization timestamps;tracks coverage;produces Unit Staging Change Card;checks Battery Swap Voucher/North Approach Queue Snapshot before service/routing;reconciles destinations using Caller Location Correction Slip;records approved routes/coverage checks;updates incident after facility-transfer confirmation;continuously monitors policy-approved queue-age/high-priority-concurrency/staffed-availability thresholds,declares surge level. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur): verifies location before medical capture,produces correction slip;confirms incident/facility before destination requests;receives Bedside Arrival Receipt,checks arrival against dispatch timeline/crew communications. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield): resolves uncertainty/disagreement,records rationale/consistency;sends Pediatric Acuity Note;advises repositioning;validates surge declaration/protocol-consistent prioritization. Triage follows capture,not reassessment replacement;immediate threats require highest-available priority/prompt dispatch;clarification cannot delay urgency;pediatric airway/breathing/circulation/mental-status concerns require prompt protocol-approved escalation. Regional Medical Director: clinical/delegation/surge priorities,specialized-destination/protocol guidance/adjustment—not dispatch authority. Data Quality Officer (Pebble): flags defects/location-status inconsistencies,routes operational corrections;reviews incomplete arrival/handover;cannot independently reprioritize. Jurisdictions own policy/boundary review. Computer Aided Dispatch Console: displays current incidents/resources/access/staging,surge level,field/facility constraints;verify currency. Ambulance Coordination Platform: matches priority/capability/availability/constraints;retains timestamped movements;displays approved destinations/instructions. Dispatchers compare response-times/remaining-coverage;recommend;regional rules authorize. Shift Commander (Sundial): receives capacity alerts,reviews coverage/access timing/transfer safety;approves coverage-reducing/nonstandard exceptions;sends Mutual Aid Release Form releasing neighboring service;assigns surge coordination,checks normal coverage;escalates unresolved destination/access issues regionally;cannot override clinical/crew authority. Radio Coordinator (Mistral): verifies reachability/backups/talkgroups;transmits incident/location/priority/assignment/hazards/destination;retries unacknowledged transmissions,alerts supervisor;sends Coverage Gap Bulletin below threshold. Regional Radio Network carries diversions/routes/acknowledgments/en-route updates. Paramedic Crew: acknowledges/repeats location/priority/destination;discrepancies require

New part:
S181: Call Taker Mara obtains the age, weight when available, and caregiver observations needed to support pediatric triage.
S182: Paramedic Crew reassesses pediatric patients during transport and reports material changes to the receiving facility.
S183: Kestrel shall confirm that facility capacity and pediatric service limitations are communicated to dispatch before a destination is finalized.
S184: Riverside Trauma Center advises Hospital Liaison Desk when trauma intake conditions may affect the suitability of an otherwise appropriate destination.
S185: Emergency Department staff acknowledge destination changes through the established coordination channel and identify any immediate access restrictions.
S186: Hospital Liaison Desk records facility responses in the regional coordination record and keeps dispatch informed of unresolved constraints.
S187: Mutual aid is requested when local staffed units cannot meet the declared response objectives or when a specialized resource is unavailable.
S188: Regional Radio Network carries mutual-aid requests, acceptance confirmations, and operational updates using the agreed regional call signs.
S189: Copperfield shall approve any temporary triage override and document its rationale before the override is applied.
S190: Ambulance Coordination Platform tracks accepted mutual-aid assignments separately from locally staffed resources to preserve an accurate coverage view.
S191: Ambulance Unit 417 may be reassigned only after dispatch confirms that its current patient-care and transport obligations permit the change.
S192: Fleet Maintenance Cell reports a vehicle restriction promptly so dispatch does not count an unavailable unit toward operational coverage.
S193: Triage Supervisor reviews the audit memo before closing a suspected duplicate incident.
S194: Data Quality Officer reviews unresolved record discrepancies through the established quality process without delaying active patient care.
S195: North Gate Status Board provides a current view of access conditions that may affect ambulance approach or handover timing.
S196: South Gate Status Board provides the equivalent access view for routes and entry points on the southern side of the region.
S197: After surge conditions ease, Shift Commander confirms that outstanding assignments, destination constraints, and staffing gaps have been handed over to the next operational period.
S198: Regional Dispatch Center maintains a degraded-radio procedure that prioritizes emergency traffic and preserves a common operating picture.
S199: Regional Radio Network operators announce channel outages, affected areas, and expected restoration times over the remaining service channels.
S200: Radio Coordinator directs crews to approved fallback channels when the primary channel is unusable.
S201: Crews acknowledge each fallback assignment and repeat critical location and destination details before moving.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
